en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – April 30, 2026
en.summary: Highlighting key accessibility developments: MassDOT's $15.6M funding for accessible vans, Missouri's website accessibility lawsuit bill, EU/UK hotel compliance efforts, Sgt. Bluff's braille story walk, and Charlotte's new Braille Trail combining art and accessibility.

highlights.title: MassDOT awards $15.6M for accessible vans and minivans
Missouri lawmakers send website accessibility lawsuit bill to governor
How hotels are adapting to the EU and UK Accessibility Laws
Sgt. Bluff story walk adds braille for accessibility
Art meets accessibility on Charlotte’s new Braille Trail

zh-TW.title: 每日無障礙消息摘要 – 2026年4月30日
zh-TW.summary: 重點報導：MassDOT 撥款 1560 萬美元購買無障礙車輛；密蘇里州立法者推送網站無障礙訴訟法案；歐洲與英國酒店適應新無障礙法律；Sgt. Bluff 故事步道加入盲文；夏洛特新盲人步道結合藝術與無障礙設計。

highlights.title: MassDOT 頒發 1560 萬美元用於購買無障礙面包車和小型客車
密蘇里州立法者將網站無障礙訴訟法案送交州長簽署
酒店如何適應歐盟和英國的無障礙法律
Sgt. Bluff 散步故事路加入盲文以提升無障礙性
夏洛特新盲人步道結合藝術與無障礙設計
